_comment: Tier-2 for dune::stokes#3 and #4. Measured 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Equal-order P1/P1 velocity-pressure assembles and solves at both 8x8 and 16x16, and the mean neighbouring-dof jump in the pressure GREW from 2.272329e+02 to 1.616683e+03 — a factor of 7 the wrong way — while the velocity maximum stayed at 0.250000 in both. So the checkerboard does not shrink under refinement and the velocity still looks plausible, which is the whole claim. For #4: closing the last boundary with a velocity Dirichlet condition left the pressure level running away to 9.904292e+16 against 2.000000 for the same problem with an open outflow, while the velocity stayed at 5.42. The solver did NOT report a singular matrix and the level was reproducible across two runs on this install, so the claim's 'shifted by an arbitrary constant that moves between runs' is not what happens here — the level is simply undetermined and lands somewhere enormous. 2026-08-06 CORRECTION: the earlier sentence here — that a 0 in the pressure slot did NOT drive the inlet pressure to zero (|p| max 1.543121 against 2.000000 with None) — was a slicing artefact. The boundary mask was built by interpolating [x[0], x[1], 0] and slicing the PRESSURE leg, which returns the constant-0 third component, so every pressure dof tested as lying on x = 0 and the 'inlet maximum' was the global maximum. Interpolating the coordinate INTO the pressure leg gives a constrained-boundary pressure of exactly 0.000000e+00 with the 0 entry against 2.000000e+00 with None, re-measured 2026-08-06. The claim holds and is now owned by scripts/tier2_fixtures/dune/stokes_pressure_slot_none_versus_zero, which counts constrained dofs (0 versus 68 at 8x8) instead of reading a maximum. This fixture still only COVERS stokes:3 and stokes:4; it now asserts the corrected pinning rather than its negation. A composite space stores its legs BLOCKED, not interleaved — 659 = 578 + 81 for an 8x8 P2/P1 pair — which is why this fixture slices by leg size rather than reshaping to (-1, 3); that reshape raises. STRENGTHENED after mutation testing: the ratio-under-refinement gate alone passed when the equal-order pair was mutated to the STABLE P2/P1 one. The fixture now also solves the stable pair on the same 16x16 grid and requires the equal-order oscillation to be orders of magnitude larger.
